create_LTX2LatentUpsamplePipeline: create an LTX2LatentUpsamplePipeline with a VAE and latent upsampler model for video upscaling
run_pipeline_call: run the LTX2LatentUpsamplePipeline __call__ method to upsample video latents with optional AdaIN and tone mapping
prepare_video_latents: prepare video latents from input video frames using the VAE encoder with configurable batch size and dimensions
apply_adain_filter: apply Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN) to blend upsampled latents with original latent statistics
apply_tone_mapping: apply non-linear sigmoid-based tone mapping to compress the dynamic range of latent values
